Every control maps to a task need: type chips double as legend and filter (index.html:25, app.js:541-558), component select + reset for query, slider + 3 buttons for the cursor; no decorative chrome in either screenshot. Minor redundancy: cursor-align has three affordances (inspector button app.js:405-408, cursor-box button app.js:579-581, C key app.js:617-619), but each targets discoverability for a different input style.

Source corroborates strong affordances: :focus-visible outlines (styles.css:504-509), aria-pressed/aria-label on chips and rows (app.js:177, 282, 528, 135-136; index.html:24-28, 53), roving tabindex with DOM order matching visual order (index.html:35 comment; app.js:290-298), 24px min-height buttons (styles.css:111, 359). frontend_rework.evidence: layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, and text.truncation all pass; both screenshots show an intact three-column layout at 1280x860 and 1440x900 with no visible truncation or collision (event titles use ellipsis, styles.css:305-311). scores.overall_note: impl-09 presents a change-set/timeline representation tightly matched to the brief's understand × temporal-sequence cell: the causal timeline dominates the initial screen (styles.css:168-169), a pre-selected pivot incident (app.js:19) makes change causality immediately readable, and a time-cursor with snapshot folding (app.js:84-94) keeps temporal structure and change semantics mutually consistent — the acceptance seed is not just represented but boot-validated and surfaced in the header self-check line visible in both screenshots (app.js:55-82, 627). Navigation is single-screen with keyboard, chip, and deep-link paths (app.js:603-650), and context is preserved through in-place selection and filter auto-reset (app.js:137-141). Receipt evidence is strong: 6/7 checks pass with layout, truncation, contrast, focus order, and target size all green; the sole failure is type.min_projected_size, consistent with the 10.5–11.5px auxiliary text in styles.css, which caps accessibility and rework scores at 4. Error rate is referenced from the receipt only and not rescored; task_completion_time, information_retrieval_accuracy, and human_preference are marked not_observable per the frozen rubric, and the time_to_understand score is explicitly the model-judged label proxy, not a human measurement.
